files.observation: Source11 is the standing rear-left caster, separate from the caster beside the hero. Its tall green orb-topped staff is visible at414-422. An orange floor warning appears at416 and counts down; the near-hero source10 caster receives its lethal hit at422.

Orange countdown remains visible at424-435 while the hero moves right. Source11 remains rear-left with a prominent raised orb/staff; the source10 death response near the hero must not be mistaken for source11 release or recovery.

At438-442 source11 staff remains raised, then dips forward/lower at444-446. At446 the orange warning becomes a yellow impact ring and damage6 appears by the hero. This is the impact boundary, not the transient idle at445.
Staff/orb rises again at454-458; by459-462 the caster is upright in a walking/reset stance. The yellow impact ring is absent by458.

files.observation: The rear-left source11 human green hood and full body are clearer. It carries the staff low and extends the free hand forward as the orange warning appears at416. The nearby source10 caster is hit lethally at422, a separate action.

Through424-435 source11 holds a mostly sustained forward free-hand gesture with the staff low near the thigh/waist. Its weapon silhouette gives a quieter windup cue than the baseline raised orb staff. The hero and dying source10 caster overlap at the right.

At438-446 the source11 free-hand/staff silhouette changes little. No clear large staff release pose is distinguishable between445 and446. The floor warning-to-yellow-impact-ring change and damage6 at446 provide the readable release timing.

At454-458 source11 still has a quiet forward hand/low-staff pose. At459-462 the free hand settles lower and the stance shifts toward walking while the impact ring is gone. Fine recovery cadence is difficult to judge at game scale.
